snippet.title: STRIKEM Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Fast, physics-driven 2D platform shooter built for chaos. Battle across Team Deathmatch, CTF, Free-For-All, King of the Hill & Coin Confirmed, survive co-op Zombie waves and the Iron Directive campaign, then grind 108 ranks of loot. Squad up with friends or drop in solo vs AI. Coming this Oct. 23rd.
